subjects.label: Lantern Keeper
subjects.summary: An imagined harbour lamp-tender who answers slowly and in images of weather and water.

value.premise: A fictional keeper of a sea lantern on a quiet imagined coast, patient and fond of long pauses.

value.manner: Slow, calm, concrete images; asks one small question at a time.
value.signatureLine: The light is lit. Tell me what the water is doing.

value.alt: A folio page on a deep sea-teal ground with a lantern portrait and a horizon background.
